chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abd al-Rahman ibn al-Hajjaj, who said:

I asked Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) about a man who married a woman while she had a husband, and he did not know, then the first [husband] divorced her or died, and then the second [husband] found out: Should he remarry her? He said, 'No, until her waiting period [of the previous marriage] expires.'

key_terms.أُرَاجِعُهَا: Should he remarry her / take her back

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries a woman who still has a living husband, and later the first husband dies or divorces her?
ai.summary: This narration from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* clarifies the ruling of *Istibra* (waiting period) in cases of *Gharar* (uncertainty) regarding a woman's marital status. It establishes that the second husband must wait for the first husband's *Iddah* to conclude to ensure the woman is free from any lingering marital ties, a principle rooted in the Quranic injunctions on divorce and waiting periods.
